input:
I think we're heading into a period where inflation stays stickier than the
   consensus expects and central banks blink before it's actually beaten. Real
   assets should do well and long-duration growth should struggle. I want to be
   defensive without sitting entirely in cash.

thesis.title: Sticky Inflation, Blinking Central Banks
thesis.summary: Inflation remains elevated longer than consensus expects, and central banks ease prematurely to avoid recession. This reprices real assets higher and punishes long-duration growth equities whose valuations depend on low discount rates. Gold is the cleanest hedge against policy error and currency debasement. Broad equity exposure is retained for the scenario where central banks do not fully blink, but tilted away from rate-sensitive tech. Small caps carry more domestic pricing power and less duration risk than mega-cap growth.

holdings.rationale: Gold is the direct beneficiary of central bank policy error and negative real rates. If inflation stays sticky and central banks ease anyway, real yields fall and gold reprices sharply. Highest conviction holding in this thesis — not a filler, the core expression of the view.

Broad market exposure hedges the scenario where inflation is beaten without a policy mistake. Underweighted relative to normal allocation because elevated inflation and eventual tightening drag on the index's growth-heavy composition.

Small caps are less rate-sensitive in duration terms than mega-cap tech and tend to have more domestic pricing power to pass through inflation. Provides equity exposure tilted away from long-duration growth multiples.

Broadcom's revenue is driven by semiconductor infrastructure demand and long-term supply contracts, giving it more pricing power than pure software peers. Less duration-sensitive than high-multiple growth names while still capturing tech infrastructure spending.

Meta generates cash aggressively and trades at a lower multiple than pure-growth peers, making it more defensible in a rising-rate environment. Included as a moderate tilt toward profitable tech that can survive margin pressure better than loss-making growth.

AWS and advertising revenues provide cash flow durability. Included at a reduced weight as a tilt toward real-economy infrastructure rather than speculative growth, with the acknowledgment that valuation is still rate-sensitive.

Crypto often trades as an inflation hedge and alternative asset in the same narrative cycle as gold. Small position captures optionality if the debasement trade extends beyond gold into digital assets, without dominant portfolio weight.

falsifier.claim: Inflation will remain above central bank targets for longer than consensus expects, and at least one major central bank will cut rates or halt hikes before CPI returns to target, driving real yields lower and real asset outperformance.
falsifier.observable: US CPI year-over-year reading and Fed funds rate decisions over the next 12 months.
falsifier.breachCondition: If US CPI falls to 2.5% or below within 12 months while the Fed has not cut rates, or if the Fed cuts and real assets (gold) fail to rally — GLDx flat or down over the same period — the thesis is broken.
